subject: MavenTo POC: success criteria, eval timeline, and model governance
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Jordan <alex@mavento.ai>, Sofia Mendes <sofia@mavento.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: MavenTo POC: success criteria, eval timeline, and model governance

Alex / Sofia — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned as we scope the POC. I’ve attached a short requirements workbook and an initial set of eval prompts.

Summary of needs you mentioned:
- Use case: customer support triage + short-answer knowledge retrieval for product docs (English + ES/PT).
- Target latency: 250ms median; 95th < 600ms for single-turn lookups.
- Quality bar: F1-ish style accuracy on annotated prompt set >= 82% (we'll operationalize exact metric).
- Data controls: MAV will not send PHI; commit to private endpoints (Dedicated or VPC).

Proposed POC scope (2-week sprint + 1-week buffer):
1) Week 0 (prep, owners): onboarding, data collection, confirm eval prompts (owner: Marissa).
2) Week 1 (integration & baseline): sandbox integration, baseline runs with candidate models (owner: Ben).
3) Week 2 (eval + triage): run evaluation harness, compare models on latency/cost/accuracy, pick production candidate + fallback (owner: Karthik).
4) Week 3 (wrap & recommendation): write runbook, handoff plan to infra/security (owner: Monica).

Model pairing recommendation for trial (initial):
- Primary: Llama 3 13B (8-bit quantized) — balance of instruction-following and latency on our infra.
- Fallback: Mistral 7B Instruct (quantized) for cheaper fast-paths; configure automatic fallback for high latency or token limits.
- Multilingual: both models have good English/Spanish coverage; for Portuguese we’ll evaluate a small fine-tuning/adapter approach if baseline falls short.

Success criteria (draft):
- Functional: >=82% accuracy on annotated prompt set across EN/ES; >=78% on PT (if adapter not used).
- Performance: median latency <=250ms; 95th <=600ms on Dedicated profile.
- Operational: automated rollout + fallback policy validated in sandbox; clear owner assignments for monitoring and alerts.

Action items (please confirm owners and dates):
- Marissa: finalize eval prompts and share annotated set (due: Thu 19 Nov).
- Ben: supply sandbox credentials & run baseline tests (due: Mon 23 Nov).
- Karthik: validate model pairing and create canary rollout playbook (due: Tue 24 Nov).
- Monica: coordinate security checklist and confirm VPC options (due: Tue 24 Nov).

Attachments: mavento_poc_requirements.xlsx (requirements workbook), eval-prompts-and-metrics.txt (seed prompts).

If that all looks right, we’ll stood up the trial environment and kick off this week.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodai.com | +1 415‑555‑0123

---

From: Alex Jordan <alex@mavento.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Sofia Mendes <sofia@mavento.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MavenTo POC: success criteria, eval timeline, and model governance

Thanks Karthik — high level looks good. A couple clarifications from our side: 
- The Portuguese requirement is lower priority; we can accept a 5% lower accuracy on PT during the POC as long as ES/EN meet the bar.
- Security: we do want to confirm encryption-at-rest for KV cache and a short audit log export for the trial. I’ve looped Sofia who leads platform.

We’re OK with the proposed models as starting points. One ask: can we include a smaller, cheaper runtime (Mistral 7B) as an additional control so we can show cost delta?

On owners/dates: Marissa confirming prompts by Thu works. Ben — can you run the sandbox baseline next week?

On the timeline, we can be flexible — if you prefer to extend the eval window by a week to collect more annotations, we can do that.

— Alex
VP Product, MavenTo
alex@mavento.ai | +1 206‑777‑0124

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: MAV POC — owners + playbook (please review)

Team — looping you in with Alex/Sofia's confirmation. They explicitly asked to include Mistral 7B as a cost-control arm (good). Updated plan below with concrete checkpoints so we can hit the SLA ask during the POC: 

POC sprint (revised):
- Prep (this week): Marissa — finalize prompts, provide annotated ~250 sample queries across EN/ES/PT (aim EN 160 / ES 60 / PT 30). Attach workbook stub for tracking.
- Baseline runs (next Mon-Wed): Ben — run Llama 3 13B (q8) and Mistral 7B baseline on sandbox; collect latency histograms, token counts, and raw outputs. Save to shared Drive (link above).
- Eval harness (Wed-Fri): Marissa/Ben — compute accuracy, F1, hallucination counts, and cost per 1k tokens. Produce a short matrix (quality vs cost).
- Decision + runbook (following Mon): Karthik/Monica — pick primary and fallback, prepare canary rollout steps, and security checklist.

Operational notes:
- Fallback policy: prefer same-inference node fallback (Mistral) when queueing delay >150ms or model memory error. We’ll also implement prefix caching for frequent KB queries.
- Monitoring: set up token-level cost alerts and 95th latency alert at 600ms.
- Data handling: confirm audit log export (JSON) and KMS key used for encryption. Monica, please confirm available VPC subnet ranges to present to MAV.

Ben — can you confirm you have the sandbox creds and estimate baseline run time (approx hours)? Also include rough cost delta per 10k queries for both models in the run notes.

Marissa — once you drop the annotated set, I’ll schedule a 30-min mid-week check to review early outputs.

Thanks — Karthik

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: MAV POC — owners + playbook (please review)

Quick status: I have the sandbox creds and can run the baseline starting Monday. Estimated runtimes: 
- Llama 3 13B (q8): 3–4 hours for the 250-sample batch (single concurrent worker).
- Mistral 7B (q8): 1.5–2 hours same batch.

I’ll push raw outputs + latency histograms to the Drive folder and drop a short cost delta table in the run notes. Regarding caching: I’ll enable prefix cache for the top 40 queries to show gains in median latency.

Monica — please advise on the KMS key which we should use (we have an org-scoped key, or we can use a customer-provided key if they want).

Marissa — ping me when prompts are in — I’ll queue the runs and share early screenshots.

— Ben
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodai.com | +1 415‑555‑0189

- mavento_poc_requirements.xlsx (requirements workbook, contains sample schema and column list)
- eval-prompts-and-metrics.txt (seed prompts + scoring rubric)
- proposed-runbook-v1.md (draft canary + rollback steps)
